individuals.title: Edit Check
individuals.quote: Offer people actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies while they are editing.

individuals.title: Editing Team
individuals.quote: The Editing Team is working on a set of improvements for the visual editor to help new volunteers understand and follow some of the policies and guidelines necessary to make constructive changes to Wikipedia projects.

individuals.title: Wikimedia Foundation Product Department
individuals.quote: why the Wikimedia Foundation's Product Department is prioritizing this work

individuals.title: Growth team
individuals.quote: created using the same functionality as the Growth team's version

individuals.title: Visual editor
individuals.quote: The visual editor's growing popularity among people who are new to editing Wikipedia

individuals.title: Reference check
individuals.quote: The first "check" the Editing Team will be introducing is one that will detect when people are attempting to add *new* content to an existing article *without* a corresponding reference and prompt them to do so.

individuals.title: Link check and Reference reliability
individuals.quote: Link check and Reference reliability

individuals.title: Paste Check
individuals.quote: Paste Check

individuals.title: Tone check
individuals.quote: Tone check

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode
individuals.quote: The feature has been available as a Beta Feature globally since early March and at English Wikipedia since early February.

individuals.title: TextMatch
individuals.quote: Some communities have started to use the textMatch feature to create custom local types of Suggestion.

individuals.title: Multi-Check
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours

individuals.title: Add an image suggestion type
individuals.quote: A new experimental suggestion type, "Add an image", has been created using the same functionality as the Growth team's version.

individuals.title: Add a link suggestion type
individuals.quote: Work is also ongoing on improving the functionality of the "Add a link" suggestion type, so that it can become a default global suggestion type in the future.

individuals.title: Hide suggestions toggle-button
individuals.quote: Addition of a toggle-button to hide suggestions temporarily - this will soon also save the 'hidden' state across future edit-sessions

individuals.title: Special:EditChecks
individuals.quote: Clearer and more accurate details in `Special:EditChecks` which shows the local configuration

individuals.title: Suggestion edit-tags
individuals.quote: Two new edit-tags added to published edits

individuals.title: Efficient Suggestions storage
individuals.quote: The team is building a way for Suggestions to be stored more efficiently, so that in the future the suggestions can be used by, or shown within, other software features

individuals.title: Edit Check desktop siderail
individuals.quote: This change shifted Edit Checks from appearing *within* articles to appearing *alongside* them, in a new "siderail."

individuals.title: Mobile publishing reference step
individuals.quote: The first version of Edit Check will introduce a new step within the *mobile* visual editor's publishing workflow that people will see if/when they add new content *without* a reference.

individuals.title: editcheck/init.js
individuals.quote: The conditions above are implemented and maintained in code here: editcheck/init.js

individuals.title: Multi-Check deployment June 2025
individuals.quote: Multi-Check was deployed to all wikis where Reference Check is currently available on June 25, 2025.

individuals.title: SSA newcomers feel safe and confident editing
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa will feel safe and confident enough while editing to publish changes they are proud of and that experienced volunteers consider useful.

individuals.title: Moderators notice quality and configure Edit Check
individuals.quote: Moderators at the English and French Wikipedias will notice improvements in the quality of edits newcomers are making and be motivated to configure how Edit Check presents policies to them.

individuals.title: Newcomers and Junior Contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa
individuals.quote: In the context of this project, we are considering people who are still "learning the basics" to be people who have published <100 cumulative edits to a single, or multiple, Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Experienced volunteers/moderators
individuals.quote: need to do more work reverting low-quality edits and posting messages on inexperienced volunteers' talk pages to make them aware of the policies and/or guidelines they are likely to have unknowingly broken

individuals.title: Wikipedia projects
individuals.quote: struggle to grow and diversify their volunteer populations and shrink the knowledge gaps present within Wikimedia wikis

individuals.title: Administrators
individuals.quote: Administrators at all Wikipedias can help to configure this tool so that it can recognize local standard heading-names

individuals.title: Editing interfaces do not surface policies
individuals.quote: The trouble is that the visual editor and other editing interfaces do not make people aware of the Wikipedia policies and guidelines they are expected to follow.

individuals.title: Visual editor succeeds at teaching technical skills
individuals.quote: the editing experience has been reasonably successful at helping inexperienced volunteers learn the *technical skills* necessary to publish changes to Wikipedia

individuals.title: Newcomer changes break established best practices
individuals.quote: the changes inexperienced volunteers publish often break established best practices and lead to undesirable outcomes for inexperienced volunteers, experienced volunteers, and Wikipedia projects as a whole

individuals.title: Offer actionable policy feedback while editing
individuals.quote: Offering inexperienced volunteers relevant and actionable feedback about Wikipedia policies in the precious moments when they are in the midst of making a change using the visual editor.

individuals.title: Equip moderators to specify feedback
individuals.quote: Equipping moderators with a new ability to specify the feedback inexperienced volunteers are presented with while they are editing

individuals.title: Timely guidance leads to valued changes
individuals.quote: This project is built on the belief that by surfacing relevant guidance in the precious moments when inexperienced volunteers are in the midst of making a change to Wikipedia and equipping them with the know-how and tools necessary to apply this guidance, they will make changes they are proud of

individuals.title: Make norms legible and actionable while editing
individuals.quote: we first need to make the norms and standards that are currently in place legible and actionable to people while they are editing

individuals.title: Newcomers twice as likely in Africa or Asia
individuals.quote: Newcomers are two times more likely to live in Africa or Asia.

individuals.title: Movement struggles to retain non-European editors
individuals.quote: The movement struggles to retain editors who live outside Europe and North America.

individuals.title: Sub-Saharan Africa underrepresented among editors
individuals.quote: people from Sub-Saharan Africa represent only 1% of active unique editors, despite representing 15% of the global population and 7% of the global internet population

individuals.title: 80% of SSA editors contribute to English or French
individuals.quote: 80% of registered editors in Sub-Saharan Africa contribute to English or French Wikipedia.

individuals.title: Minimize false positives approach
individuals.quote: the Editing Team is pursuing an approach with Edit Check that minimizes the likelihood of false positives and is implemented in ways that empower volunteers, on a per-project basis, to evolve the heuristic to become more robust over time

individuals.title: Activate when new paragraph added
individuals.quote: A minimum of one new paragraph of text is added to the article someone is editing

individuals.title: Activate when new paragraph lacks reference
individuals.quote: The "new paragraph(s) of text" someone has added does NOT include a reference

individuals.title: Activate only in main namespace
individuals.quote: The changes described in "1." and "2." are happening on a page within the main namespace (NS:0)

individuals.title: Guidance feels intuitive so newcomers return
individuals.quote: Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors find the guidance Edit Check is presenting them with, and the editing experience more broadly, to be intuitive and straightforward so that they feel encourage to return to edit again

individuals.title: Avoid creating extra work for experienced volunteers
individuals.quote: Decrease the likelihood that Edit Check is creating more work for experienced volunteers by prompting newcomers and Junior Contributors to add sources when they are not needed

individuals.title: Moderators configure when and for whom Edit Check activates
individuals.quote: The Editing Team thinks it is crucial that moderators be empowered to configure when, and for whom, Edit Check becomes activated.

individuals.title: Audit and edit activation logic
individuals.quote: **Audit** and **edit** the logic that determines when the reference Edit Check becomes activated

individuals.title: Review edits of people shown Edit Check
individuals.quote: **Review** the edits people who are shown Edit Check are making

individuals.title: Multi-Check (References) A/B Test
individuals.quote: To learn whether the Multi-Check was effective at causing, newcomers to publish new content edits that include references while lowering the likelihood those edits would be reverted, we ran an A/B test with 12 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Multi-Check Phase 1 Impact Analysis
individuals.quote: To decide how – if at all – this change impacted volunteer disruption and edit quality, we compared analyzed several key metrics shifted before and after this change.

individuals.title: Reference Check A/B Test
individuals.quote: To learn whether the Reference Edit Check is effective at causing **newcomers to make edits they intended and experienced volunteers value**, we conducted an A/B test with 15 Wikipedias.

individuals.title: Suggestion Mode A/B experiment
individuals.quote: We are now preparing for an A/B experiment with newcomers at ~20 Wikipedias, to measure what kind of impact the tool has on the percentage of constructive (un-reverted) edits by newcomers

individuals.title: LLMs effective at verifying source corroboration in English
individuals.quote: This research confirmed that in English LLMs are effective at evaluating whether web-based sources corroborate claims on Wikipedia.

individuals.title: Multi-Check increased referenced unreverted edits
individuals.quote: Multi-Check caused statistically significant increases in the proportion of edits that include a reference and are not reverted within 48 hours without causing undesirable changes in edit completion or other forms of disruption (e.g. blocks).

individuals.title: Multiple checks 1.3x more likely to add reference
individuals.quote: Edits that were shown multiple Reference Checks in a session are **1.3 times** more likely to include at least one new reference in the final published edit compared to sessions shown a single Reference Check.

individuals.title: 34.7% revert rate decrease with multiple checks
individuals.quote: there was a **-34.7% decrease** in revert rate when directly comparing edits presented multiple checks compared to edits presented a single reference check

individuals.title: 5.5% increase in users publishing referenced edits
individuals.quote: Overall, there was a **5.5% increase** in the proportion of distinct users who published a new content edit with a reference when multi-check was available.

individuals.title: No completion decrease up to 5 checks
individuals.quote: There were **no decreases** in edit completion rate for up to 5 reference checks being presented in a single session

individuals.title: Multiple checks shown at 19% of new content edits
individuals.quote: multiple reference checks were shown within a single editing session at **19% of all published new content VE edits (549 edits)** by unregistered users and users with 100 or fewer edits

individuals.title: 76.1% completion rate with multiple checks
individuals.quote: The edit completion rate for sessions that were shown multiple checks within a session was **76.1% compared to 75%** for sessions shown only one check

individuals.title: 52.5% of multi-check edits include reference
individuals.quote: **52.5%** of all published edits shown multiple Reference checks included at least one new reference compared to **39.7%** of edits that were shown a single check

individuals.title: 17% revert rate with multiple checks
individuals.quote: the revert rate of new content edits shown multiple Reference Checks (**17%**) is currently lower compared to sessions shown a single Reference Check (**26%**)

individuals.title: Siderail reduced revert rate 15.7%
individuals.quote: The revert rate of new content edits where Reference Check was activated decreased by **15.7%**.

individuals.title: Siderail increased referenced edits 8%
individuals.quote: The proportion of new content edits that included a reference following the change increased **8%**.

individuals.title: Siderail increased edit completion 3.2%
individuals.quote: Excluding reverted edits, there was **3.2%** increase [2 percentage points] in edit completion rate.

individuals.title: Reference decline rate decreased 4.7%
individuals.quote: The rate at which people *declined* to add a reference when Edit Check prompted them decreased **4.7%.**

individuals.title: Siderail design change net positive
individuals.quote: The findings above suggest this design change has been net positive.

individuals.title: Reference Check increased quality without disruption
individuals.quote: Reference Check caused an **increase in the quality of edits** newcomers publish and **did not cause any significant disruption**.

individuals.title: Reference Check default-on would be net positive
individuals.quote: This combination is leading the Editing team to be confident that offering Reference Check as a default-on feature would have a net positive impact on all wikis and the people who contribute to them.

individuals.title: 2.2x more likely constructive referenced edit
individuals.quote: People shown the Reference Check are **2.2 times more likely** to publish a new content edit that includes a reference and is constructive (not reverted within 48 hours).

individuals.title: 4.2x more likely on mobile
individuals.quote: The highest observed increase was on mobile where contributors are **4.2 times more likely** to publish a constructive new content edit with a reference when Reference Check was shown to eligible edits.

individuals.title: Revert rate decreased 8.6%
individuals.quote: New content edit revert rate **decreased by 8.6%** if Reference Check was available.

individuals.title: SSA edits 53% less likely reverted
individuals.quote: New content edits by contributors from Sub-Saharan Africa are **53% less likely** to be reverted when Reference Check is shown to eligible edits.

individuals.title: 16% more likely to return in second month
individuals.quote: Contributors that are shown Reference Check and successfully save a non-reverted edit are **16 percent more likely** to return to make a non-reverted edit in their second month (31-60 days after).

individuals.title: 10% decrease in edit completion rate
individuals.quote: Overall, there was a **10% decrease** in edit completion rate for edits where Reference Check was shown.

individuals.title: No increase in block rate
individuals.quote: There were **decreases or no changes** in the rate of users blocked after after being shown Reference Check and publishing an edit compared to users in the control group.

individuals.title: 1.8% false negative rate
individuals.quote: Only **1.8%** of all published new content edits in the test group did not include a new reference and were not shown Reference Check.

individuals.title: 6.6% false positive dismissals
individuals.quote: **6.6%** of contributors dismissed adding a citation because they indicated the new content being added does not need a reference.

individuals.title: Increase edit quality of SSA newcomers
individuals.quote: Increase the quality of edits newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa publish in the main namespace

individuals.title: Increase reference inclusion by SSA newcomers
individuals.quote: Increase the likelihood that newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will accompany the new content they are adding with a reference

individuals.title: SSA newcomers report feeling safe and confident
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors editing from within Sub-Saharan Africa will report feeling safe and confident making changes to Wikipedia

individuals.title: Volunteers audit and iterate default configurations
individuals.quote: Experienced volunteers will independently audit and iterate upon Edit Check's default configurations to ensure Edit Check is causing newcomers and Junior Contributors to make productive edits.

individuals.title: Newcomers more aware of need for references
individuals.quote: Newcomers and Junior Contributors will be more aware of the need to add a reference when contributing new content because the visual editor will prompt them to do so

individuals.title: Risk: edit quality decreases
individuals.quote: Edit quality decreases

individuals.title: Risk: unreliable citations harder to patrol
individuals.quote: Edits become more difficult to patrol because unreliable citations are difficult to detect

individuals.title: Risk: edit completion rate drastically decreases
individuals.quote: Edit completion rate drastically decreases

individuals.title: Risk: edit abandonment drastically increases
individuals.quote: Edit abandonment rate drastically increases

individuals.title: Risk: blocks increase
individuals.quote: Blocks increase

individuals.title: Risk: high false positive or negative rates
individuals.quote: High false positive or false negative rates

individuals.title: Risk: Edit Check too resource intensive
individuals.quote: Edit Check is too resource intensive to scale
